title: 第2966章 再拿下一位鬼府府主第2965章 五具
slug: 万倍返还我收徒百无禁忌
content_zh:
万道虚空与群宇宙。
两方大道界面虽说几乎相连，但两者之间，也是存在有一片狂暴虚空乱流区域的。
只是部分界域有与万道虚空直接相连的通道。
而此刻，在两方大道界面之间，这片狂暴虚空乱流区域内。
正一座通体弥漫着灰色朦胧气体的诡异阁楼，悬浮在其中一处角落。
阁楼顶层的阳台上。
此时正立着一位灰发，身穿华贵衣袍的中年。
中年紧紧盯着不远之外的万道虚空虚空边界方向，眼中闪烁着迟疑，“以紫鬼的实力，这动作，有些迟缓了呀！”
距离紫鬼潜入万道虚空到现在，已经过去了三日。
对于紫鬼这样一位半步万道境而言，在提前掌握目标宇宙的坐标情况下，于一方大道界面活擒一批生灵，按理说根本要不了两日。
就算动作慢点，眼下三日还未有动静……
灰发中年心头莫名泛起一股不安。
但又有些迟疑。
来之前，大府主详细介绍过万道虚空。
这不过是一方在群宇宙庇护下的大道界面，内部情况，大府主早已探清。
最强的，也就是那叫张云的人类，所带着的少数战神级战力。
就算紫鬼真撞上，要应付也不难。
眼下……
灰发中年望着万道虚空边界的方向沉吟了下，伸手触及狂暴乱流遍布的虚空，打出了一道特殊的印记。
很快。

从群宇宙的方向，一条银光大道锁链穿透层层狂暴虚空乱流，来到了灰发中年身前。
“大府主……”
灰发中年当即对着银光大道锁链开口。
但才刚说完尊称，像是突然感应到什么，灰发中年神情骤然一凝。
直接一个转身。
身下的诡异阁楼猛然转动。
啪！
但还未能转上一圈，诡异阁楼就被一只遍布战之大道力的巨大手掌，当场抓停。
一尊充斥战之大道力的巨人，猛然从狂暴虚空乱流间现身而出。
不等灰发中年来及多想。
突然感觉周围区域的狂暴虚空乱流剧烈波动。
立马抬头。
就见一柄遍布金光的大道巨剑，竖直斩开乱流，朝他和诡异阁楼斩了下来。
“！！”
content_en:
All voids and universes.
Although the interfaces of the two avenues are almost connected, there is also an area of ​​violent void turbulence between the two.
Only some realms have channels directly connected to the void of all directions.
At this moment, between the interface of the two avenues, in this area of ​​violent void turbulence.
There is a strange attic filled with gray hazy gas, suspended in one corner.
On the balcony on the top floor of the attic.
At this time, a middle-aged man with gray hair and luxurious clothes stood.
The middle-aged man stared closely at the boundary of the void not far away, with hesitation in his eyes, "With the strength of Zigui, this movement is a bit slow!"
Three days have passed since Zigui sneaked into the void.
For a person like Zigui who is in the Half-step Ten Thousand Dao Realm, and who knows the coordinates of the target universe in advance, it should not take more than two days to capture a group of creatures alive at the interface of Yifang Dao.
Even if the movement is slower, there has been no movement for three days now...
The gray-haired middle-aged man felt inexplicably uneasy.
But there was some hesitation.
Before coming, the Grand Master gave a detailed introduction to Ten Thousand Void.
This is just a road interface under the protection of the universe. The palace master has already found out the internal situation.
The strongest one, that is, the human named Zhang Yun, has a handful of God-of-War-level combat power.
Even if the purple ghost really hits him, it won't be difficult to deal with it.
Right now...
The gray-haired middle-aged man looked at the direction of the boundary of the void and pondered for a moment, then stretched out his hand to touch the void filled with violent turbulence, and made a special mark.
soon.
From the direction of the universe, a chain of silver light penetrated through the layers of violent void turbulence and came to the gray-haired middle-aged man.
"Master of the Palace..."
The gray-haired middle-aged man immediately spoke to the chain of Silver Avenue.
But just after saying the honorific, as if he suddenly sensed something, the gray-haired middle-aged man's expression suddenly condensed.
Turn around immediately.
The strange attic beneath him suddenly rotated.
Snap!
But before it could even make a full circle, the Weird Pavilion was stopped on the spot by a huge palm filled with the power of war.
A giant filled with the power of war suddenly appeared from the violent void turbulence.
Don’t wait until the gray-haired middle-aged to think too much.
Suddenly, I felt the violent void turbulence in the surrounding area fluctuating violently.
He immediately looked up.
He saw a giant sword covered with golden light, cutting through the turbulent flow vertically, and slashed towards him and Weird Pavilion.
"!!"
